Column sums telescope. The independently programmed exhaustive checker passed 160 exact rational comparisons for n=3..8; all-order proof does not depend on enumeration.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The total-count covariance and limiting 1/12 are ALREADY COVERED as coefficient derivatives of established joint generating functions; they are explicitly not asserted as new. A generating function with one variable per statistic counts all sites together, so it does not determine which record position i covaries with which peak position j. The new claim is exactly that position-resolved matrix.
